measurement_note: Size is n, the array length. The legal 10-, 20-, and 40-element tiers span 4x, use m = 3, and keep k near n/2. The accepted combinatorial formula performs linear work in the smaller side of the binomial coefficient. A correct slower dynamic program carries counts for every attainable number of equal boundaries after every position, taking quadratic work on these tiers.
